en: A monochrome (black‑and‑white) industrial scene showing a large sawmill complex by the water with timber logs laid out in long rows in the foreground. In the middle stands a long, light-colored factory building with many windows and a tall chimney emitting little or no smoke. Surrounding it are smaller wooden houses and industrial structures, with forested hills in the background. Printed captions in Swedish appear along the bottom margin of the image.
